values.description: Assess reliability by triangulating reward behavior against a trusted policy, a synthetic oracle reward, and an ensemble of reward models.

includes.label: Trusted-policy distribution comparison
includes.description: Compare deployed policy action distributions with a trusted baseline to identify anomalous behavior.

includes.label: Synthetic oracle reward reference
includes.description: Using a high-quality synthetic oracle reward as a gold reference for evaluating proxy-reward optimization.

includes.label: Reward-model ensemble agreement
includes.description: Using multiple reward models and requiring agreement before trusting reward assessments.

values.label: Source-model reward-effect triangulation
values.description: Assess reliability by combining a synthetic oracle or source-model comparison with ensemble-based checks to isolate and validate reinforcement-learning effects on reward behavior.

includes.label: Synthetic oracle reward reference
includes.description: Using a high-quality synthetic oracle reward as a gold reference for evaluating proxy-reward optimization.

includes.label: Reward-model ensemble agreement
includes.description: Using multiple reward models and requiring agreement before trusting reward assessments.

includes.label: Reasoning-to-source model comparison
includes.description: Compares a reasoning model with its source model to isolate reinforcement-learning effects on reward hacking.

values.label: Proxy-to-gold reward gap
values.description: A widening divergence between optimized proxy reward and gold reward that exposes overoptimization.

values.label: Reward-model data-volume effect
values.description: Reward-model training-data volume changes gold-reward quality and the extent of Goodharting.

selected_clusters.name: Production Policy Lineage
selected_clusters.description: Which deployed policy versions, variants, inference data, rollback events, and environments are traceable?

relations.reading: Choices on Production Policy Lineage limit the options available on Policy Promotion and Exposure
relations.rationale: Version, variant, environment, and rollback traceability constrain safe promotion and exposure decisions.

values.label: Registry-anchored policy lineage
values.description: Tracks deployed policy versions through their training histories and uses model-registry status to identify rollback targets. This provides basic traceability for deployment and recovery.

includes.label: Production policy lineage tracking
includes.description: Connect deployed policies to their training histories and associated experiments.

includes.label: Model-registry rollback targets
includes.description: Use registry promotion status to identify an unambiguous previously known-good policy version.

values.label: Auditable rollback lineage
values.description: Combines registry-based rollback targeting with explicit audit records of rollback triggers, source versions, target versions, and timing.

includes.label: Model-registry rollback targets
includes.description: Use registry promotion status to identify an unambiguous previously known-good policy version.

includes.label: Rollback event audit logging
includes.description: Record rollback triggers, timestamps, source versions, and target versions for post-mortem analysis.

values.label: End-to-end deployment evidence lineage
values.description: Links live endpoints and variants to training jobs and retained inference data, while anchoring deployed versions and rollback targets in policy lineage records.

includes.label: Production policy lineage tracking
includes.description: Connect deployed policies to their training histories and associated experiments.

includes.label: Model-registry rollback targets
includes.description: Use registry promotion status to identify an unambiguous previously known-good policy version.

includes.label: Production-variant traceability
includes.description: Record links from a live endpoint to its deployed model variant and originating training job.

includes.label: Inference capture-data retention
includes.description: Persist production requests, responses, metadata, and time-partitioned records for later evaluation.

values.label: Operational capture with environment isolation
values.description: Retains production inference records while separating training infrastructure from serving infrastructure to protect production stability and latency.

includes.label: Inference capture-data retention
includes.description: Persist production requests, responses, metadata, and time-partitioned records for later evaluation.

includes.label: Separated training and inference environments
includes.description: Keep training and serving infrastructure separate to preserve serving stability and latency.

selected_clusters.name: Policy Promotion and Exposure
selected_clusters.description: Which pre-production and rollout process exposes and promotes candidate policies?

relations.reading: Policy Promotion and Exposure requires Training Artifact Configuration to be decided first
relations.rationale: Safe promotion and rollback depend on identifying candidate versions, their training history, and known-good restoration targets.

values.label: Counterfactual testing in CI/CD
values.description: Test alternative policy actions offline before deployment without unsafe online exploration.

values.label: Policy safety gates
values.description: Require offline evaluation and simulated safety checks before staging or production promotion.

values.label: Shadow deployment
values.description: Observe a candidate policy under production conditions without allowing it to affect live decisions.

values.label: Canary or blue-green rollout
values.description: Limit production exposure through controlled rollout patterns that support observation and containment.

values.label: Counterfactual policy-value gating
values.description: Uses logged-data estimates and their uncertainty to gate policy promotion.
